### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [x] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version of the `main` branch

### Module(s)

mini.snippets

### Neovim version

0.11.x

### Description

I saw that 4151bc69c210679c35d2152c9a726eb2a9f86f1a introduced `start_lsp_server()` and tested it out with `mini.completion`, which worked great! However, when using built-in completion, certain snippets are either expanded incorrectly or not at all.

I'm not sure if this is a Neovim core limitation/issue, expected behavior or user error.

The reproduction steps use a `Makefile` as example but this is not an issue tied to filetype, at least not in my experience.

### Reproduction

1. Create separate 'nvim-repro' config directory:
    - '~/.config/nvim-repro/' on Unix
    - '~/AppData/Local/nvim-repro/' on Windows

2. Inside 'nvim-repro' directory create a file named 'init.lua'.
   Populate it with the following content:

    ```lua
    -- Clone latest 'mini.nvim' (requires Git CLI installed)
    vim.cmd('echo "Installing `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
    local mini_path = vim.fn.stdpath("data") .. "/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim"
    local clone_cmd = { "git", "clone", "--depth=1", "https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim", mini_path }
    vim.fn.system(clone_cmd)
    vim.cmd('echo "`mini.nvim` is installed" | redraw')

    -- Make sure 'mini.nvim' is available
    vim.cmd("packadd mini.nvim")
    require("mini.deps").setup()

    vim.o.completeopt = "menuone,noinsert,popup,fuzzy"

    local snippets = require("mini.snippets")
    snippets.setup({
      snippets = {
        snippets.gen_loader.from_file(vim.fn.stdpath("config") .. "/snippets/global.json"),
        snippets.gen_loader.from_lang(),
      },
    })
    snippets.start_lsp_server()

    vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("LspAttach", {
      group = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup("LspAttach", { clear = true }),
      callback = function(ev)
        local client = assert(vim.lsp.get_client_by_id(ev.data.client_id))
        if client:supports_method("textDocument/completion") then
          local chars = {}
          for i = 32, 126 do
            table.insert(chars, string.char(i))
          end
          client.server_capabilities.completionProvider.triggerCharacters = chars
          vim.lsp.completion.enable(true, client.id, ev.buf, { autotrigger = true })
        end
      end,
    })
    ```

3. Inside 'nvim-repro' create a directory named 'snippets' and inside it, a file named 'make.json'.
   Populate it with the following content:

   ```json
   {
     "Alvo de ajuda": {
       "prefix": "help",
       "body": [
         ".PHONY: help",
         "help: ## Mostrar esta mensagem",
         "	@printf \"\\nUso: make [opção]\\n\\n\"",
         "	@grep -E '^[a-z.A-Z_-]+:.*?## .*$$' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | sort | \\",
         "		awk 'BEGIN {FS = \":.*?## \"}; {printf \"\\033[36m%-30s\\033[0m %s\\n\", \\$\\$1, \\$\\$2}'"
       ],
       "description": "Gerar alvo de ajuga (help)"
     },
     "Data": {
       "prefix": "date",
       "body": ["${CURRENT_YEAR}-${CURRENT_MONTH}-${CURRENT_DATE}"],
       "description": "Inserir data no formato (Y-m-D)"
     }
   }
   ```

4. Run `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-repro nvim` (i.e. execute `nvim` with `NVIM_APPNAME` environment variable set to "nvim-repro").
   Wait for all dependencies to install.

5. Open a `Makefile` and try to expand snippets with built-in completion:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a09da2df-c71d-4173-a52c-72bf8926d3ea

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the issue!

Both of the instances have nothing to do with `start_lsp_server()`, but are examples of how [snippet parsing in 'mini.snippets'](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/c404fc5717866ff738aadeeb1f54ab8ed270ae1e/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L1199) differs from the one described in [LSP spec](https://microsoft.github.io/language-server-protocol/specifications/lsp/3.17/specification/#snippet_syntax), while built-in `vim.snippet.expand()` (which is used in `vim.lsp.completion`) is designed to follow the LSP spec as strictly as possible (although it is not 100% there yet):
- The first snippet contains `.*$$' $(MAKEFILE_LIST)` part which contains unescaped `$` signs. This is not allowed by the snippet grammar, while 'mini.snippets' falls back to treating dollar signs as regular character if it is not recognized as a start of tabstop or variable. Replace that part with `.*\\$\\$' \\$(MAKEFILE_LIST)` and it should work with built-in `vim.snippet` as well.
- `CURRENT_YEAR` / `CURRENT_MONTH` / `CURRENT_DATE` are variables that are not supported by the LSP spec (hence not recognized by `vim.snippet`), but are supported as a wider set of variables from VS Code (and [supported by 'mini.snippets'](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/c404fc5717866ff738aadeeb1f54ab8ed270ae1e/doc/mini-snippets.txt#L247-L250)).

Closing as everything works as expected.

title: Issues with `start_lsp_server()` snippet expansion and built-in completion
